blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — US President Donald Trump said Saturday he was offering a press secretary role to mixed martial arts executive and “violent fighter” Dana White. “I am pleased to announce that the Great Dana White, a violent Fighter and Warrior, has been offered the job of Press Secretary of the United States,” Trump wrote on his Truth Social account. “Dana, please take the job!” he said. While White did not explicitly accept the job, the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) boss posted a photo — possibly AI-generated — that showed him behind the lectern in the White House press briefing room, […]...
